integrity: The proof states its dependence on the known equal-cube theorem and uses executable finite checks as corroboration, not as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Dimension three and integer Manhattan metric only. The homotopy-type baseline invokes an earlier theorem on equal-sided finite cubes; the exact rectangular multiplicities and integral basis are proved separately. Unindexed equivalent literature could exist.
title: Exact Rips persistence and unit-cube homology bases of three-dimensional Manhattan boxes
